questions.prompt: Name a plant commonly grown as a houseplant.
questions.scope: Actual documented indoor houseplants, named groups/species/cultivars count. Do not accept every wild plant merely because it can temporarily fit in a pot.
Recognized succulent plants and documented public groups/species/cultivars count. Do not automatically include all descendants of a mixed succulent/non-succulent genus.

Documented carnivorous plants and recognized named groups count. A whole mixed genus must not bring in non-carnivorous species. Fictional man-eating plants do not count. Cultivar epithets need their plant/genus qualification. Registered and independently documented cultivated forms count; a nomenclatural status alone does not decide real horticultural use.
